page.overview:
Who is Bernardo Hertogs?

Bernardo Hertogs is a South American former racing driver. Hertogs serves as mechanic to James Bond, whose secret mission is to protect a British racing driver at the Nürburgring racetrack. The character appeared in Anthony Horowitz's 2015 James Bond continuation novel Trigger Mortis.

A South American with greying hair and aristocratic features, Hertogs is a former racing driver who raced with Alan Fairfax, the father of Logan Fairfax, competing in the Panamericana in 1951. By 1957, he has retired to work alongside the pit mechanics; purely to be close to the cars. Believing James Bond to be a wealthy playboy looking to compete in the Nürburgring race, he assists the spy by providing advice and tending for his Maserati racing car. In reality, 007 prepares to compete against a SMERSH assassin.
